scope: Election of the Chamber of Representatives (Zastupnički dom Sabora Republike Hrvatske) of 2 August 1992, all 138 seats in every tier: national lists (17 lists, votes, printed percentages, 60 seats), 60 single-member constituencies (every candidate's votes, printed percentage and elected status, shown by nominators and row number), four national-minority special constituencies (4 seats; candidates without names), and the 14 members declared elected from national lists (13 for the Serbian community, 1 for minorities under 8%; counted per list, no names), with registered voters, voters, invalid ballots and printed turnout per decision. The Chamber of Counties (Županijski dom, 1993), candidate names, list members, the analytical per-constituency list tables and polling-station results are not covered.

owner_decisions.decision: Owner brief "Complete ten-country parliamentary election coverage" naming www.izbori.hr; answers "Accept for all four" (Copyright Act, official texts) and "Register both" (manual reading only).

Owner supplied the 1990–1995 results documents from the izbori.hr archive (five 1992 files); asked which pre-2000 elections to attempt, the owner answered "1992, 1993 and 1995 only" (1990 out of scope).

reuse_right.basis: Same basis as the other Croatian admissions: official texts of state bodies are not protected (Croatian Copyright Act), owner reading; not a licence.

normalized_republication.basis: Per-tier and per-constituency counts, list votes, printed percentages and seats; list names as printed (no person named); single-member candidates shown only by the nominator abbreviations printed with them (or NK, independent) and the row number; minority candidates by row number only; members declared elected from national lists counted per list, without names or community of any person.

raw_redistribution.basis: The scanned decision files (national lists, 6 pages; constituencies, 65 pages) and the three analytical files received but not used stay in local-evidence/ by SHA-256 only.

acquisition_route.basis: Saved by the owner from the registered www.izbori.hr archive (results files of the 1992 parliamentary election); the assistant made no request.

source_files_complete.basis: The national-list decision of 10 August 1992 (URBROJ 56605-92-527) and all 64 constituency decisions of 11 August 1992 (KLASA 013-03/92-01/05, URBROJ 56605-92-463 to -526, consecutive): single-member constituencies I–LX and special constituencies 1–4. Files 3–5 (analytical list tables and the quotient table, which prints candidate names) are recorded as received and not used.

national_definition_complete.basis: Per decision: list or candidate votes + invalid ballots = voters; printed turnout and invalid shares recompute; every printed percentage = votes ÷ voters (invalid ballots included, the 1992 base) rounded to two decimals; a 3% threshold gives the same seven lists on voters or on valid ballots and D'Hondt reproduces 31/12/5/4/3/3/2 of 60; each elected candidate has most votes (printed elected names compared with the rows, not stored); members declared elected from lists 2 + 8 + 3 = 13 and 1, with 4 special-constituency seats + 1 = the printed minimum of 5; 60 + 60 + 4 + 13 + 1 = 138. OCR (macOS Vision) read the figures; the 18 units whose OCR failed a check or gave a non-standard label, and every other unit's nominator column, were read by eye.

same_election_identity_complete.basis: Lists and candidates per tier and unit as printed; no link across tiers or elections; single-member winners grouped only by identical printed nominator string; members declared elected from lists counted per list only.

electoral_system_metadata_complete.basis: The Election Act as cited in the decisions (Narodne novine 22/92 and 27/92; Arts. 10, 24, 26, 31, 50, 51) and the Constituencies Act (Narodne novine 33/92, Art. 5): D'Hondt for national lists, plurality in single-member and special constituencies, Serbian seats in proportion to the printed 1981 census share and a minimum of five seats for minorities under 8%. The decision prints no threshold; 3% reproduces the seats and is recorded as a reproduction, not a citation (the statute text was not read).

vintage_decisions_complete.basis: Final decisions of the Electoral Commission of the Republic of Croatia of 10 and 11 August 1992 in the scanned files of the commission archive; figures read by OCR with every unit reconciled arithmetically; failing units and all nominator labels checked by eye.

continuity: None: no party register was reviewed, so no link is made between elections, even where a name repeats. continuous_party_series is 0.
